title: Official Metadata Addon Execution Locality Deepening
problem: Residual shallow Seams still tunnel provider execution, provider catalog, and render drift facts through central Modules after earlier architecture lanes.
gates: cargo nextest run -p nako-metadata-scraper bulk provider_execution --no-fail-fast
cargo nextest run -p nako-metadata-scraper provider registry config --no-fail-fast

evidence.summary: Workstream opened from architecture review and user-approved fearless refactor goal.
Bulk Metadata Scrape now overlays provider execution facts through typed ProviderRunPolicy and no longer mutates request JSON with provider_execution_policy.
Rendered-page proxy/session configuration facts moved into provider catalog entries, so Config delegates those checks to ProviderRegistry instead of matching every rendered provider kind.
Render drift case generation now uses provider catalog descriptors for sample env, fallback, order, and builder facts instead of central per-provider branching.
Package, format, JSON, and diff hygiene gates passed; closeout review found no blocking findings for the three target locality refactors.

continue_policy.notes: Lane complete. Split notification, Chromecast, or default field-provider preference ownership into separate lanes if prioritized.
